summary: FS Credit Real Estate Income Trust filed an 8-K reporting a Fifth Amendment to its Master Repurchase Agreement with Bank of Montreal. The amendment extends the availability period from April 16, 2027 to April 17, 2028. The filing is a routine refinancing or covenant modification for an existing credit facility, not a special situation. No change in ownership, price, or business strategy is disclosed. The event lacks typical special-situation triggers such as a merger, tender offer, activist campaign, or restructuring. The filing merely reflects ongoing debt management and does not warrant classification under any special-situations category.
